reel_script:
Hook (0-3s): “Machine learning? It’s not magic.”

Scene 1 | Visual: Fast-paced montage of messy data – overflowing spreadsheets, tangled code snippets, a confused-looking person staring at a screen. | Voiceover: “You think it’s about complex algorithms and brilliant insights.”

Scene 2 | Visual: Close-up shot of someone meticulously cleaning and organizing data – filtering, correcting errors, transforming columns. | Voiceover: “Turns out, it’s mostly about cleaning your ingredients.” 

Scene 3 | Visual: Transition to a clean, organized dataset displayed beautifully.  A smiling person reviews it. | Voiceover: “Garbage in, garbage out. Seriously.”

Closing line: “Start building smarter, one clean dataset at a time.”
